description: This Java class 'AzureIotHubUtil' provides utility methods for constructing Azure IoT Hub connection strings, generating SAS tokens, and retrieving default CA certificates from specific directory paths within the project structure.

classes.name: AzureIotHubUtil
classes.description: A utility class for constructing Azure IoT Hub connection strings, generating SAS tokens, and retrieving CA certificates.

methods.name: buildUsername
methods.description: Constructs the IoT Hub device username using the host and device ID.

methods.name: buildSasToken
methods.description: Generates a SAS token for Azure IoT Hub authentication based on host, SAS key, and current time.

methods.name: buildExpiresOn
methods.description: Calculates the expiry time for the SAS token based on the provided clock.

methods.name: getDefaultCaCert
methods.description: Reads the default CA certificate file from a specified path or directory, returning its contents as a string.
